The '''Nulan system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nulan VI]].

==Behind the scenes==
The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Nulan system in grid square O-18.
